video_title: Gui Santos gets ‘swagger back’ in Warriors’ win vs. Celtics | NBC Sports Bay Area

quotes.speaker: Gui Santos
quotes.summary_phrase: Gui Santos on the Warriors' defensive focus against the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: If it's a night that we can't score, but we cannot let them score too

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Gui, Steve Kerr said you guys needed to dig out of a hole with defense, so grind it out tough the win. How did you do it?

text_blocks.speaker: Gui Santos
text_blocks.text: Steve was talking to us a lot about how we've been playing defense the last couple games. We had a great meeting yesterday, we all talking and we are in the same page. That's what we need to do. If it's a night that we can't score, but we cannot let them score too. If we have to win a game like this 88 to 87, we got to do it. We got to find a way, and today was a day that we did it.

quotes.social_post: Gui Santos says the Warriors defensive focus was the key to beating the Celtics. He noted that even on nights where the shots are not falling they have to find a way to win by locking in on the other end of the floor.

structured.context: Gui Santos discusses the team defensive focus against the Celtics following a meeting with head coach Steve Kerr.

quotes.speaker: Gui Santos
quotes.summary_phrase: Gui Santos on the Warriors' fourth-quarter intensity
quotes.excerpt: we were not even worried about how the score is, we just playing super hard

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: The Celtics had a huge third quarter. You guys responded with a huge fourth quarter. How do you stay locked in those moments where every possession matters?

text_blocks.speaker: Gui Santos
text_blocks.text: We know the games like that, we have up and downs, but we just got to keep playing. We got to keep playing hard. In moments in the fourth quarter that we were playing super hard, we were not even worried about how the score is, we just playing super hard and the score comes automatically with that.

quotes.social_post: Gui Santos on the Warriors fourth quarter intensity against Boston. He says the team stopped worrying about the scoreboard and just focused on playing hard to let the result come naturally.

structured.context: Gui Santos explains how the team maintained intensity during the fourth quarter against the Celtics.

quotes.speaker: Gui Santos
quotes.summary_phrase: Gui Santos on his confidence and physical health

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: You had two really big threes in the fourth quarter. How are you feeling right now? How's your confidence? How are you moving out there?

text_blocks.speaker: Gui Santos
text_blocks.text: I'm feeling that I'm getting my swagger back. Still working a lot, getting my body 100% healthy, and I just want to be that guy for the team every night. If I have to hit threes, okay, I do it, but I got to be the guy that's going to be impacting the game without even touching the ball.

quotes.social_post: Gui Santos says he is finally getting his swagger back. He wants to be a player who impacts the game even without touching the ball.

structured.context: Gui Santos describes his current physical health and confidence level after hitting two key three-pointers.

quotes.speaker: Gui Santos
quotes.summary_phrase: Gui Santos on Draymond Green's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: just let him guard the best player of the other team and we going to be good

text_blocks.speaker: Kerith Burke
text_blocks.text: Finally, can you tell me how you saw Draymond approach this game?

text_blocks.speaker: Gui Santos
text_blocks.text: You can see the last possession, right? He does what he does. We know that we are 100% covered with him. Just let him guard the best player of the other team and we going to be good. We know that he going to do a great job.

quotes.social_post: Gui Santos on the defensive impact of Draymond Green. He says the team feels 100 percent covered whenever Draymond is on the floor because he is always going to do a great job guarding the best player.

structured.context: Gui Santos praises the defensive impact of teammate Draymond Green during the final possession of the game.
